workarounds.note: level 1 restates breakBefore (parity 'odd') because any headings object drops the H1 break
every frontmatter value is quoted: title and author feed the cover and the running heads
col() writes the hex beside the paletteId, because the cover, opener and running-head designs do not read the palette
the lead's design-text lineHeight is the multiple LEAD / 9.5, never a Dimension, which would drop the opener's reservation
the lead sets paragraphIndent: pt(0.01) so that the \n in each lead attribute breaks the line; at 0 the lead prints the two characters \n and wraps where the measure ends
design text cannot be justified, so the small-caps lead is a centred display of two lines broken by sense instead of a justified first line
bodyText.maxRuntTracking: 0: at the default, the paragraph ending 'nodding good-by to him.' is set a line shorter with negative tracking the canvas does not paint
the U+00A0 after Mr. and Mrs. holds only in plain paragraphs; in the two paragraphs with italics it is an ordinary space, and neither line happens to break there
locale is the exact bundled code ('en-us' | 'pt'): 'pt-BR' would hyphenate the Portuguese edition as American English

the cover style sets span: 'page' in this single-column book: kept in the column, its design is clipped at the column top (165 mm down, the section's margin), so the art disappears and the title loses its top
